out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the hand sink by the tilt skillet
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. STAFF REFILLED THE PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) In the 2DR stacked Hot Box (right side): pork butt (126-133f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT PORK BUTTS IN THE OVEN TO 165f BEFORE HOT HOLDING AT 135f. PIC MOVED PORK BUTTS TO OVEN A BEGAN REHEATING.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed mouse droppings in corner of the walk-in cooler used for cooling.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC AND MANAGEMENT TO CONTACT THEIR LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR FOR ADDITION SERVICES IF PEST ACTIVITY INCREASES. MANAGEMENT PROVIDED THE LAST TWO MONTHLY INVOICES FOR THEIR PEST CONTROL. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT TO SEAL/FILL ALL HOLES AND GAPS IN THE WALLS AND CEILING TO PREVENT PEST ENTRY. MANAGEMENT STATES HE REPAIR SEVERAL HOLES AROUND THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK LAST WEEK AND HAS NOT OBSERVED ANY MORE ACTIVITY WILLARD'S REAL PIT BBQ (Inspection Date: 06/17/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed several broken tiles around the base board in the dining area. Observed a hole in the corner of the large door/wall adjacent to the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. REPAIR ALL BROKEN TILES AND SEAL HOLE TO ELIMINATE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR under counter by the register, heavy cream was observed at 46f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE HEAVY CREAM.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed Caesar dressing being stored in the walk-in for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE DRESSING.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: A manufacturer bottle of vinegar was observed being used to store Caesar dressing.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. DO NOT REUSE MANUFACTURER BOTTLES. REPLACE WITH A NSF APPROVED CONTAINER.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 3DR prep top cooler was observed at 50f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC HAD A SERVICE TECHNICIAN LOOK AT THE COOLER ON SATURDAY AND IS WAITING FOR PARTS FOR REPAIR. PIC HAS EVERYTHING ON ICE IN THE TOP OF THE PREP TOP. PIC IS KEEPING NON-TCS ITEMS IN THE BOTTOM PART OF THE COOLER.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: EHS observed handwashing sink sin the back of the kitchen and on the expo line of the kitchen not being able to meet 100F minimum requirement.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC TURNED UP THE HOT WATER VALVE SO HANDWASHING SINSK WERE ABLE TO REAHC 100F MINIMUM.
